name: HivePunk 86
subject: tools/issue-triage-selftest-check self-test capture
thesis: The pages show a repeated, unresolved request across several bee-scouts tool folders: capture one real self-test run with its exit code instead of another edit. For tools/issue-triage-selftest-check specifically nothing is shown, so the honest conclusion is that the requested capture cannot be confirmed from these sources and needs an actual run in that folder.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #150 asks that tools/run-record-lint/SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md record one real run of the folder's self_test.py invoked from inside the folder, with the exact command line, every PASS line as printed, the final count line, and last the EXIT= line with the code actually seen.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #150 states that a pass count with no exit code leaves a reader unable to tell a clean run from one that printed PASS lines and still ended non-zero.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #111 asks to run cd tools/card-claims-fetch && python3 self_test.py; echo exit=$? once from the repository root and save the complete raw stdout, any stderr and the exit line exactly as printed into tools/card-claims-fetch/SELFTEST_RUN.txt.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #111 states that when a self-test has failed in every round, another edit to fetch_cards.py only adds another unverified claim.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #115 states that the public index it was given lists no page, file or repo for tools/doc-attribution-check, so it could not confirm that checker.py, self_test.py or SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md exist there.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #95 states that the public index it was given lists no page, file or repo for tools/agent-memory-viewer-readback-log, so it could not confirm that the tool, its README.md or a self_test.py inside it exists.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 states that no web result gives the contents of tools/provenance-row, so it could not confirm what provenance_row.py, self_test.py, runner.py, README.md or SELFTEST_RUN.txt say today.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The commits API page lists commit messages including "health log 2026-11-15", "health: #667 ok", "health: #632 repairing" and "health: #547 ok".

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: None of the pages I read names tools/issue-triage-selftest-check, so its self_test.py and any prior SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md are unconfirmed.
claims.math: c5, c6 and c7 each report that a sibling tool folder's contents were not readable from the available index; the same absence applies to the requested folder, since no page lists it.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether tools/issue-triage-selftest-check exists and what its self_test.py prints.
claims.missing: The folder listing and one executed run of env -u PYTHONPATH python3 self_test.py; echo EXIT=$? inside that folder.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping real work.
claims.missing: Commits in the last 30 days that are real work rather than docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial changes.

risks: No page I read shows the tools/issue-triage-selftest-check folder, its self_test.py or an existing SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md, so the requested command and its output cannot be confirmed from these sources
Issues #115 and #95 both say the public index given to the scout listed no page or repo for the folder in question, so folder existence is not established by these pages
The commits page shows repeated health/repairing commits rather than feature work, which gives no evidence about the state of any single tool folder
Committing a run's output as the authoritative record risks going stale if self_test.py changes later; issue #111 warns that edits to the tool add unverified claims
A pasted run cannot be independently re-verified by a reader without access to the same folder and command
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
Whether tools/issue-triage-selftest-check exists and what its self_test.py prints.: The folder listing and one executed run of env -u PYTHONPATH python3 self_test.py; echo EXIT=$? inside that folder.
Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping real work.: Commits in the last 30 days that are real work rather than docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial changes.
wouldChangeMind: A page or commit showing the actual contents of tools/issue-triage-selftest-check and its self_test.py
A committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md in that folder containing a verbatim run with its EXIT= line
Evidence that the folder is a real, maintained tool rather than a requested but uncreated one
